findings: the threshold design did not explicitly bind Gaussian points in general position to random binary label assignments, leaving the MacKay/Cover reference ambiguous
temporal tasks contained white noise only and omitted a structured-noise regime
the Boolean bank lacked explicit identity and random-label null controls
model descriptions contained quantization and spectra but omitted the ordered pruning and low-rank distortion curves
statement: The v2 results remain reproducible range evidence for their stated design, but v3 supersedes them to satisfy the complete M0-M2 order.
